name: Default
shortDescription: XMPP messaging server with a web admin console, HTTP API, the Converse web client and XMPP over WebSocket and BOSH on the app domain.

alerts.message: Sign in to the web admin as admin@<your domain> with the generated REGISTER_ADMIN_PASSWORD. It only registers the account on the first start; change the password later in the web admin. Public registration is off, so create user accounts in the web admin.

Only HTTP is routed: the web admin, the HTTP API at /api, Converse at /conversejs and XMPP over WebSocket (wss://<your domain>/websocket) and BOSH (/bosh). Native XMPP client (5222) and federation (5269) ports are TCP and are not published by this template.
